description: admiral-io org-wide Renovate preset. Per-repo configs extend this via {"extends": ["local>admiral-io/.github"]}.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: admiral SDK packages — bump on any release, no delay (we control them)
Admiral container images (ghcr.io) — bump on any release
GitHub Actions — group bumps, pin to SHA, keep version comment
Group Go indirect dep patch/minor bumps
Group all @types/* updates together (they tend to move with their parent package major)

Go minor releases — go directive (go.mod) and the golang builder image move in one PR, 30 days after release so golangci-lint and the ecosystem have caught up. Patch bumps stay in the weekly non-major group (a 1.X-alpine tag already floats them). Dockerfiles also set GOTOOLCHAIN=auto so a go directive that lands ahead of the image tag downloads the toolchain instead of failing.
golangci-lint in its own PR — the workflow pin and the tools/ script pin land together, and new lint rules get reviewed apart from dependency bumps

customManagers.description: golangci-lint binary version — the `version:` input of golangci-lint-action in workflows and GOLANGCI_LINT_VERSION in tools/golangci-lint.sh. No built-in manager sees either. A golangci-lint built with an older Go refuses to lint a go.mod targeting a newer one, so this pin must not lag the Go version.
